prompts: The city was a dame in a red dress, and I was the sap falling for her charms. I needed a smoke, and a clue. Not necessarily in that order.
The rain was coming down in sheets, just like my rent was due. I had a gut full of cheap whiskey and a case that was going nowhere fast.
She walked into my office like a cat walks into a room full of rocking chairs. All grace, and a hint of danger.
